name: Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy
definition: X-linked dystrophinopathy causing progressive childhood-onset proximal weakness, Gowers sign, calf pseudohypertrophy and later cardiopulmonary complications.

investigations.principle: CK is usually markedly elevated; genetic testing confirms diagnosis; cardiac and respiratory surveillance are essential.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, vascular, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Disease-modifying and steroid strategies require specialist protocols and monitoring.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Bala/Mamsa-kshaya phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: X-linked dystrophinopathy causing progressive childhood-onset proximal weakness, Gowers sign, calf pseudohypertrophy and later cardiopulmonary complications.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
